items.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said Friday he won’t prejudge what the U.S. central bank will do about interest rates at its upcoming meetings in October and December.

items.title: Chip selloff deepens Wall Street losses as doubts grew over AI returns
items.summary: A significant selloff in semiconductor stocks affected major US indexes amid rising concerns regarding AI investment returns. The Nasdaq 100 dropped by 1.8%, continuing its longest losing streak since 2008. Market participants are questioning if AI infrastructure investments will yield profitable returns despite strong demand for chips. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh maintained a neutral stance on interest rates during discussions at the IMF meetings.

items.title: Traders bet on October interest-rate hold after Kevin Warsh is tight-lipped at conference
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stayed mum Friday on the path for interest rates, even after hot inflation data this week – which traders took as a sign officials will hold rates steady this month.

items.title: S&P 500 Holds Steady as Fed Rate Hold Expectations Rise After Warsh Remarks
items.summary: The S&P 500 Index was little changed on Friday, as indications that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady this month heartened investors despite continued worries about the viability of the artificial intelligence trade.

items.title: Fed’s Warsh sees AI boosting productivity but gives no signal on next rate hike
items.summary: US Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said in Bangkok on Friday that the global economy has proved surprisingly resilient and called AI the most consequential change of his lifetime, but gave no hint on interest rates ahead of the Fed’s meeting this month.
